purpose: Separate actual estimator-spectrum removal from trivial perturbations before evaluating stability; exploratory fixed diagnostic, not target-information proof
semantics: Measure removed absolute magnitude of actual cap150 GCC spectrum, not power or semantic target information. Effective deletion must yield valid LS and have>=5 shared finite pairs each removing>=3 retained bins and10%-80% spectrum magnitude. Require>=2 effective deletions for stable/sensitive; otherwise unknown. Both screening methods pass unknown, reject sensitive. Full-invalid never promoted. No new direction, widening, refit or tuning.
diagnostics: Also record removed f^2-weighted magnitude fraction as an uncalibrated correlation-curvature proxy, not Fisher information. Classify no_change,uncomparable,weak_or_excessive,effective; deletion failure is not stability evidence.
scope: 144 matched new-seed trials; all thresholds fixed before runs, no fitting or model selection. Prior LOO compared on exact same inputs.
